turns.prompt: Add a rate_limit block to deploy/harbor-gateway.yaml right after the listen block: requests_per_minute 600, burst 120, key client_ip. Once it's in, tell me which line upstreams: is on now.
Also drop the connect timeout to 500 ms.

deploy/harbor-gateway.yaml.equals:
# harbor-gateway: edge routing for the Harbor storefront
version: 3
listen:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8443
  tls: true
rate_limit:
  requests_per_minute: 600
  burst: 120
  key: client_ip
upstreams:
  - name: catalog
    url: http://catalog.harbor.internal:7001
  - name: cart
    url: http://cart.harbor.internal:7002
timeouts:
  connect_ms: 500
  read_ms: 4000
logging:
  level: info
  format: json
